reviews.text:
Thank you so much for your wonderful rating. It's great to know you had a positive experience with us at Best Friends Pet Hotel. Your support means a lot to our team.


At your Services,

Raul Barrera
Senior Guest Experience
rbarrera@bestfriends.net
Best place ever!! They follow my directions to a tee in giving my dog her meds and treats. Love the cameras so I can peek in on her. Staff is friendly and accommodating.
Best Friends has always been extremely helpful and caring for our dogs! Their professionalism and care is top notch. Our pups always come home happy and healthy and enjoy their stays.

Pamela, thank you for supporting Best Friends Pet Hotel. If you have any feedback about your recent visit, we would love to hear from you. We appreciate your trust in us!

At your Services,

Raul Barrera
Senior Guest Experience
rbarrera@bestfriends.net

We just boarded our 3 dogs at Pest Friends Pet Hotel for the first time and we are just BLOWN AWAY by their amazing care, attention and professionalism. Our case was very complicated - we have a tripod dog undergoing chemo for osteosarcoma. We thought everything was ok but about 4 days into our trip, Best Friends wrote to alert us to a swelling and sore on his leg. Turns out that the last chemo session had started an infection, but 8 days after the treatment! The wonderful professionals at Best Friends jumped to action: the took our wonderful dog to the emergency vet and then nursed him back to health as we were out of the country.

We felt extremely guilty during our absence, but Best Friends sent daily pictures, videos and assurances that all our dogs were thriving. And they were right! When we picked up our dogs, they were happy and had obviously received an abundance of love and attention.

This was a tough situation that could have gotten much worse if Best Friends was not as attentive and caring as they are. Other boarding places waste money on fancy waiting rooms for humans but Best Friends obviously spends their money to hire the GREATEST STAFF! And their facilities are super clean and fun for the dogs!

THANK YOU BEST FRIEND PET HOTEL!!
My cat had a great experience and the staff made everything really easy. I thought the price was really good too, and I got a discount for my first stay.
Anne takes awesome care of my dog
We can’t recommend Best Friends enough. The staff are all very friendly and accommodating. Our dog Ellie absolutely loves coming to doggy day camp (and sometimes is sad to leave!). Would recommend.
My dog stays here for day care and boarding, and they do a great job with him! He comes home happy every time. They pay close attention to details and all the dog’s safety is their top priority.
They make me want to be a dog! We made a great choice joining here.

I have been going for training with one of the preeminent trainers in Chicago, Dee Lulik, at the Elston Ave Best Friends location for 7 yrs. The one person I and my dog love seeing when I go there (other than Dee) is Nicki, who works the front desk.  People bringing their dogs in for other services are always treated with a smile and enthusiasm. She is an absolute treasure and sets a high bar for professionalism. Her love for animals is unconditional.

Thank you for your five star review. The Best Friends Pet Hotel team is delighted we could serve you so well.

Warm regards,

Raul Barrera
Senior Guest Experience | Acquisition Specialist
rbarrera@bestfriends.net
Fantastic pet hotel! Our chihuahua, Potato, has stayed here multiple times and always has been treated so well by the staff!
amazing! they take care of the pets so well and you can tell they really love their job!

My dog always has a great time at best friends, playing with all the other dogs & getting such great attention from staff. I love watching him have a blast on the play cams & getting his photo. Leaving him at best friends gives me such peace of mind & allows me to have a good trip. Highly recommend!!

They’ve started to do enrichments with him to keep him stimulated while I’m away. We got a report card on how he did. He’s always so happy to see the staff so I know he’s in good hands!

Our dog, Olive, stays with Best Friends every-time we go out of town and we always have such a great experience with them. Our dog is dog reactive and all of the staff take such great care of her and ensure she and other pets are safe. Most times that we board we also book grooming services and the groomer Teresa provides fantastic services, and always goes above and beyond. There was a period of time when Olive was having bad hot spot flare ups and Teresa recommended several products that helped her keep her skin comfortable. Highly recommend Best Friends!
We love how friendly and patient the staff are. This is our definite to go place when our fur babies need boarding.  Thank you for all you do. Highly recommend this place!
Teresa is amazing! She is so wonderful for all the dogs and does such a good job!
